description: This file defines a class EmployeePunchInOutMenuConfigurator that implements the MenuConfigurator interface to configure menu items related to employee punch-in/out features within the OrangeHRM Attendance plugin. It primarily overrides the module and screen context to 'time' and 'viewAttendanceRecord'.

classes.name: EmployeePunchInOutMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for employee punch-in/out, overriding module and screen contexts to 'time' and 'viewAttendanceRecord'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the module and screen in the current context to 'time' and 'viewAttendanceRecord' respectively; returns null.
